method: paired TNFA pose conservation and IPSAE product ranking
scope: All completed hash-indexed paired predictions at frozen snapshot; incremental missing pose metrics with corrected canonical whole-complex TM
ipsae: Symmetric Dunbrack v4 residue-specific d0 best D-to-A/B/C, PAE<10 A, contact diagnostics15 A; human/mouse arithmetic mean.
ranking: Mean IPSAE times target-aligned binder pose TM; top10 per parent design run for updated report
binder_pose_tm: Fixed identical-sequence binder CA correspondence under target-only proper Kabsch fit. All human/mouse homologous target CA sites across trimer; enumerate six protomer copy permutations. Among fits within0.1 A of best target RMSD take greatest binder pose TM. d0=max(0.5,1.24*(L-15)^(1/3)-1.8) for L>15, else0.5. No binder fitting.
whole_complex_tm: USalign Mouse vs Human, -mol prot -mm1 -ter1 with explicit selected chain map. Second TM score normalized to Human full complex. Separate diagnostic.
dockq: DockQ2.1.4 symmetric average Human-reference and Mouse-reference comparison, native atom identities retained. Collapse mapped trimer to receptor R and binder to D; explicit homologous residue-number mapping including gaps, no_align=True. Only binder–trimer interface, no target–target score domination. Contact5 A, interface10 A, native references are predictions. Fixed copy map chosen by target-aligned binder pose TM.
preservation: Read-only native structures. New immutable score output and temporary adapters only. No changes to predictions or GPU recovery settings.
